name: Asset Editor
description: The Asset Editor lays a campaign asset's headline, body and CTA over its picture and lets you change their text, position, size, color, background and font.
shortDescription: Place, style and save the text on a campaign creative
fullDescription: The Asset Editor (#/asset-edit) opens one campaign asset, from the Edit button on an asset in Campaign Studio or on a campaign page, or from the Asset Editor card in Brand Studio (which opens your brand's most recent asset). It shows a canvas in the asset's platform shape (for example 1:1 for Instagram Feed, 16:9 for Web Banner) with the picture filling it and the Headline, Body and CTA laid on top on a 3 x 3 grid. Pick a block with the Headline / Body / CTA tabs or by clicking it on the canvas, then change its Text, Position, Size, Align, Color, Background and Font in the right-hand panel. The top bar has Swap image and Clean background (AI makes a new picture), Upload image, Animate →, a status message and Save. Your brand's colors and fonts are offered as choices. Changes are kept only when you click Save ('Asset saved').
bestFor: Anyone finishing a Campaign Studio creative who wants the copy placed and styled on the picture.
whenToUse: The text on a campaign asset needs to move, resize or change color.
You want to reword the headline, body or CTA of an asset.
You want a different picture behind the text: a new AI picture, a text-free background or your own upload.
You want to send the finished picture to Animate Studio.
whenToUseAnother: Use Campaign Studio (#/campaign) to create assets in the first place.
Use the Brand DNA Editor (#/brand-dna) to change the brand colors and fonts offered here.
Use Edit Studio (#/edit) for retouching the picture itself.
Use Animate Studio (#/animate) to turn the picture into a video.
keyFeatures: Canvas in the asset's platform shape with live text over the picture.
Headline / Body / CTA tabs; click a block on the canvas to select it.
Text, Position (3 x 3 grid), Size, Align, Color, Background and Font controls per block.
Brand colors as swatches and brand fonts in the Font list.
Swap image and Clean background (AI), Upload image.

featureExplanations.explanation: The main area shows the asset in its platform's shape (Instagram Feed, LinkedIn and Facebook Ad 1:1; Instagram Story 9:16; X / Twitter, Web Banner, Email Header and YouTube Thumbnail 16:9) with the picture filling it. The headline, body and CTA are drawn on top; Click a text block to select it; the selected block has a dashed outline. New campaign assets start with all three blocks at the bottom left, the headline huge and white, the body small and white, and the CTA medium black text with a white background.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: See exactly how the creative will look while you edit.
featureExplanations.inputRequired: An asset opened from a campaign.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Tall formats are limited to 75% of the window height. A block with empty text is not shown on the canvas.

featureExplanations.explanation: Three tabs above the controls choose which text block the panel edits. Clicking a block on the canvas does the same.
featureExplanations.restrictions: One block is edited at a time.

featureExplanations.explanation: A text box with the selected block's words. The canvas updates as you type.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Reword AI copy or fix typos.
featureExplanations.restrictions: No word limit is applied here (Campaign Studio's platform word limits only apply when the copy is generated).

featureExplanations.explanation: Nine buttons (top left, top center, top right, middle left, middle center, middle right, bottom left, bottom center, bottom right) place the selected block in that part of the canvas. Blocks sharing a position stack in order Headline, Body, CTA.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Put the text where the picture has empty space.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Only these nine spots; there is no free dragging.

featureExplanations.explanation: Four sizes: small, medium, large and huge. Sizes scale with the canvas width.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Set the visual hierarchy between headline, body and CTA.
featureExplanations.restrictions: No exact point size can be typed.

featureExplanations.explanation: left, center or right text alignment for the selected block.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Match the alignment to the block's position.

featureExplanations.explanation: Text color for the selected block: swatches for white, black and your brand's primary and secondary colors, a color picker, and a box where you can type a hex code (placeholder '#3366ff').
featureExplanations.restrictions: Only brand colors saved as six-digit hex codes (like #c9a24a) appear as swatches.

featureExplanations.explanation: A color behind the selected block's text. The first swatch (crossed out) means none; then white, black and your brand colors, plus a color picker and a hex box (placeholder '(none)'). The canvas shows the color as a box behind the text (rounded for body and headline, a pill shape for the CTA).
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Make text stand out on a busy picture or give the CTA a colored button shape.
featureExplanations.restrictions: This colors the text block, not the whole canvas. Choose none to remove it.

featureExplanations.explanation: A dropdown with your brand's Detected Fonts (marked '(brand)') followed by System Sans, System Serif, System Mono, Inter, Helvetica and Georgia. Each option is shown in its own font.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Use your brand typeface or a clean fallback.
featureExplanations.restrictions: A brand font only displays correctly if your browser has it.

featureExplanations.explanation: Two top-bar buttons that ask the AI for a new picture for this asset from its campaign concept. Swap image ('Generate a new image for this asset') makes a picture with the current headline drawn into it; Clean background ('Generate a clean background with no baked-in text') makes one with no text. While working the button reads 'Regenerating…' and other picture buttons are disabled. Then the status says 'New image ready — save to keep it'.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Try another visual without leaving the editor.
featureExplanations.inputRequired: An asset that came from a Campaign Studio concept, and a connected API key.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Shows 'This asset has no campaign concept to regenerate from' if the asset has no concept or platform. The new picture is lost unless you click Save.

featureExplanations.explanation: Pick an image file from your computer to use as the picture. The button reads 'Uploading…' while it works; then the status says 'Image uploaded — save to keep it'. If hosting the file fails, the editor keeps a local copy and says 'Upload failed (...); using a local copy'.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Use your own photo behind the copy.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Images only. A local copy is stored inside the browser's brand data, so very large files may not save. Click Save to keep it.

featureExplanations.explanation: The 'Animate →' button sends the current picture to Animate Studio.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Turn the creative's picture into a short video.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Only shown when the asset has a picture. It sends the picture only, not the text you placed on it.

featureExplanations.explanation: Save stores the headline, body and CTA text, the picture and the full layout (positions, sizes, colors, fonts) with the asset. It shows the toast 'Asset saved' and the status 'Saved'. Before that the status reads 'Edit, then save.' or 'Unsaved changes'.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Keep your edits; the campaign page and Campaign Studio cards then show the new text.
featureExplanations.restrictions: There is no undo, auto-save or download/export button.

featureExplanations.explanation: '← Back to campaign' opens the campaign page this asset belongs to (or the Brand DNA page if the asset has no campaign).
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Return to the other assets of the campaign.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Unsaved changes are lost; click Save first.

howToUse: 1. In Campaign Studio or on a campaign page, click Edit on an asset. 2. Click Headline, Body or CTA (or click the text on the canvas). 3. Change the Text, then pick Position, Size, Align, Color, Background and Font. 4. Repeat for the other blocks. 5. Optionally click Swap image, Clean background or Upload image for a new picture. 6. Click Save and look for 'Asset saved'. 7. Click Animate → to animate the picture, or '← Back to campaign'.
howToSteps: Click Edit on a campaign asset.
Edit Text, Position, Size, Align, Color, Background and Font.
gettingStarted: Open the editor from an asset's Edit button, or click the Asset Editor card in Brand Studio to open your brand's most recent asset.
Generate at least one asset in Campaign Studio first; without one, the Brand Studio card opens Campaign Studio with the message 'Create a campaign first to edit its assets'.
inputs: Text for Headline, Body and CTA
requiredInputs: A saved campaign asset (opened via its Edit button)

inputDetails.name: Position
inputDetails.description: One of nine spots on a 3 x 3 grid.

inputDetails.name: Uploaded image
inputDetails.description: Your own picture behind the text.

modeExplanations.description: A new picture from the asset's campaign concept with the current headline drawn into it.
modeExplanations.useCase: When you want the headline baked into the picture.

modeExplanations.description: A new picture from the concept with no text, leaving space for the overlaid copy.
modeExplanations.useCase: When you place the text with the editor's controls.

modelCapabilities: Swap image and Clean background use the same picture route as Campaign Studio: 'nano-banana-edit' with the brand logo as a reference when the logo is a PNG, JPG or WebP image, otherwise 'nano-banana' text-to-image, in the asset's platform aspect ratio. Text editing and layout need no AI.
outputs: The updated asset (text, picture and layout) saved in your browser
limitations: Opens only with an asset: from an asset's Edit button or Brand Studio's Asset Editor card (latest asset).
Text sits on a fixed 3 x 3 grid; no dragging.
No undo; unsaved changes are lost when you leave.
Animate sends only the picture, without the overlaid text.

limitationDetails.impact: You cannot download the finished creative with its text from here.
limitationDetails.workaround: Take a screenshot of the canvas, or use the picture via Animate.

limitationDetails.impact: Opening #/asset-edit directly, without an asset, shows 'Asset not found'.
limitationDetails.workaround: Click Edit on an asset in Campaign Studio or on a campaign page, or use the Asset Editor card in Brand Studio.

troubleshooting: 'Asset not found - Open an asset from a campaign to edit it.': open the editor with an asset's Edit button, or from Brand Studio's Asset Editor card once your brand has an asset.
'Brand not found - Select a brand first to edit assets.': the asset's brand was removed; create or pick a brand in Brand Studio.
'This asset has no campaign concept to regenerate from': this asset cannot use Swap image or Clean background; use Upload image instead.
'Upload failed (...); using a local copy': the picture is still used; click Save, or try a smaller file.
My changes are gone: they were not saved; edit again and click Save.
No Animate → button: the asset has no picture yet.

troubleshootingSteps.issue: Text is hard to read on the picture
steps: Pick a Background color for it, or switch Color to white or black.
Or click Clean background for a text-free picture.

commonProblems.whyItHappens: Swap image draws the headline into the picture while the editor also overlays it.
commonProblems.howToFix: Use Clean background instead, or clear the overlaid headline text.

commonProblems.problem: Brand font looks like a default font
commonProblems.whyItHappens: The font is not available in your browser.
commonProblems.howToFix: Choose a system font from the Font list.

exampleWorkflows.title: Fix a banner
steps: Click Edit on a Web Banner asset.
Headline: Position top left, Size huge.
CTA: Color set to a brand color.

exampleWorkflows.title: Own photo with brand copy
steps: Click Upload image and pick your photo.

useCases.title: Brand-consistent social post
useCases.description: Polish an AI creative with brand fonts and colors.
useCases.expectedOutput: A saved asset with styled copy over its picture.

faqs.question: How do I open the Asset Editor?
faqs.answer: Click Edit on an asset in Campaign Studio or on a campaign page. The Asset Editor card in Brand Studio opens your brand's most recent asset; if the brand has none it opens Campaign Studio ('Create a campaign first to edit its assets'), and with no brand it shows 'Analyze a brand first, then create a campaign to edit its assets'.

faqs.question: Can I download the result?
faqs.answer: No, the editor has no download or export button.

faqs.question: Can I drag the text?
faqs.answer: No. Use the nine Position buttons.

faqs.question: Where do the color swatches come from?
faqs.answer: White and black plus your brand's Primary and Secondary colors from the Brand DNA page.

faqs.question: Do Swap image and Clean background use AI?
faqs.answer: Yes. They make a new picture from the asset's campaign concept; Clean background leaves out text.

glossary.Block: One piece of text on the canvas: Headline, Body or CTA.
glossary.CTA: Call to action, the short action phrase such as 'Shop Now'.
glossary.Clean background: A new AI picture with no text in it.
glossary.Swap image: A new AI picture that includes the headline.

tips: Use Clean background when you place text with the editor.
Pick a text Color that contrasts with the picture.
Save often; there is no undo.
bestPractices: Keep the headline short for small formats.
Check contrast between text and picture.

relatedStudioGuidance.whenToMove: You need new assets or platforms.
The swatches or fonts are wrong.
relatedStudioGuidance.why: The editor reads them from the Brand DNA.

relatedStudioGuidance.whenToMove: You want a video of the picture.
